predecessors.name: Sajid dynasty
predecessors.text: Azerbaijan, taken by Marzuban from Daysam in 941, ending the Sajid dynasty

successors.name: Rawadid dynasty
successors.text: most of Azerbaijan, overrun by the Rawadids around 979; the last Sallarid holding there fell in 984

successors.name: Nizari Ismaili state
successors.text: Shamiran/Tarom, "likely destroyed soon after [1062] by the Assassins, who dismantled Shamiran"

ledger.x: 948: the Rawadids take land northeast of Tabriz.
948: the Shaddadids take the Dvin area.

c. 979: the Rawadids overrun Azerbaijan. 'The Rawadids overran much of the province around 979'; Ibrahim was deposed, 'the end of the Sallarids as a major power in Azerbaijan'; in 984 the Rawadids captured Marzuban b. Isma'il, the last Sallarid holding in Azerbaijan.
c. 979: Arran and Derbent leave Sallarid hands with Ibrahim's deposition. The page does not say who took them or where Ibrahim ruled after 971; bridging.
ledger.cp: local rulers of Arran and Derbent

ledger.x: c. 979: Sallarid overlordship of the Shirvanshahs ends with Ibrahim's deposition.
989: 'Buyid Fakhr al-Daula took Shamiran by marrying and divorcing Nuh's widow.'
1062: the last Sallarid, Musafir, pays tribute to Toghril at Shamiran.

wars.name: Rus' raid on Barda and the Hamdanid attacks
wars.outcome: Marzuban 'successfully repelled attacks by the Rus and the Hamdanids of Mosul' (941); in 943-944 a Rus' campaign captured Barda, after which Ganja replaced it as the major city of Arran.

wars.name: Buyid and Rawadid-Shaddadid war on Marzuban (948)
wars.outcome: Marzuban won a winter campaign against al-Husain in 945-946 but was defeated and captured by Rukn al-Dawla in 948; the Rawadids took land northeast of Tabriz and the Shaddadids the Dvin area.

wars.name: Shaddadid conquest of Ganja (971)
wars.outcome: Lashkari I took Ganja from the Musafirids, ending their influence in Arran.

wars.name: Rawadid conquest of Azerbaijan
wars.outcome: The Rawadids overran much of the province around 979 when Ibrahim was deposed; in 984 they captured Marzuban b.

certainty.note: Mountain emirate and frontier lordships: the pages name cities and provinces, never lines.
